hooks.command: d=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; s=$(git -C "$d" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); n=$(printf "%s" "$s" | grep -c "^[^?]"); u=$(printf "%s" "$s" | grep -c "^??"); [ "$n" -gt 0 ] && printf '{"systemMessage":"git: %s uncommitted tracked file(s), %s untracked path(s) — commit is part of done. This hook never commits for you."}\n' "$n" "$u"; exit 0
